items.title: Super Micro’s stock soars after surprise update — with Dell and HPE shares joining the rally
items.description: Super Micro unexpectedly disclosed that its revenue and profitability could be much stronger than originally anticipated.

items.title: Tesla’s stock rises as Elon Musk drops new clues about a possible SpaceX merger
items.description: Special committees at both companies are assessing merger prospects but a combination is no sure thing, Musk says.

items.title: My wife says we can’t afford to retire. I vetoed her $8,000 trip to Italy. We’re in our 60s and have $4 million. Do I keep working?
items.description: “I worry about healthcare, long-term care, inflation, a long bear market and living to 95.”

items.title: Netflix vows to revive viewership trends, but investors hit ‘sell’ on the stock
items.description: Streaming service cites “intense competition’ and acknowledges ‘some investor concern about our view hours growth.”

items.title: My partner of 17 years left me his $1 million home. His children say I influenced him to do so. Should I share my inheritance?
items.description: “I never paid rent, although I put about $45,000 toward a new kitchen and a roof.”

items.title: Walmart takes aim at Amazon and Costco with new membership program — but is it a good deal?
items.description: Some analysts question whether people will actually take advantage of Walmart’s new bundle, and how easy it is to make sense of the benefits.

items.title: It’s no secret what the best financial advice for retirement is — but most people ignore it anyway
items.description: Research can prove a lot of facts, but that doesn’t mean it changes how people act.

items.title: Bull markets tend to peak with a whimper, not a bang — but a 15% correction for the S&P 500 may be next
items.description: Unlike bear-market bottoms, which typically end with a spasm of despair as traders throw in the towel, bull-market tops are far more gradual and less dramatic.

items.title: The Social Security Administration corrected millions of records, and says there’s more to fix
items.description: In an effort to thwart fraud, the Social Security Administration said it has fixed millions of records and is working on correcting millions more.

items.title: Wall Street researchers just used Claude to design a drug. The experiment has spawned a new investment thesis.
items.description: For years, artificial-intelligence evangelists have boasted about the technology’s capacity to revolutionize drug development and medical research.
